name: Admin Panel — Full Resource Sweep
description: Login as admin@jawla.test and navigate every Filament admin resource to verify they load without errors

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/login
On the login page, type 'admin@jawla.test' into the email field and 'password' into the password field, then click the login/submit button
Assert that after login the page redirects to the /admin dashboard and not back to the login page
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin (Admin Dashboard)
Assert the Admin Dashboard loads and shows widget content like Sales Today, Visits Today, or Outstanding Balance
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/users (User Management)
Assert the Users page loads and shows a list of users or a data table
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/customers (Customer Management)
Assert the Customers page loads and shows a customer list or data table
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/products (Product Management)
Assert the Products page loads and shows a product list or data table
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/invoices (Invoice Register)
Assert the Invoices page loads and shows an invoice list or data table
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/proforma-invoices (Proforma Invoices)
Assert the Proforma Invoices page loads and shows a list or data table
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/payments (Payment Register)
Assert the Payments page loads and shows a payment list or data table
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/return-records (Returns)
Assert the Return Records page loads and shows a list or data table
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/stock (Stock Balances)
Assert the Stock page loads and shows stock levels or a data table
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/van-transfers (Van Transfers)
Assert the Van Transfers page loads and shows transfer records or a data table
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/routes (Route Management)
Assert the Routes page loads and shows route list or data table
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/daily-visit-assignments (Visit Assignments)
Assert the Daily Visit Assignments page loads and shows assignments or a data table
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/alarms (Alarm Register)
Assert the Alarms page loads and shows alarm list or data table
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/complaints (Complaints)
Assert the Complaints page loads and shows complaint list or data table
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/expenses (Expense Register)
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/cash-reconciliations (Cash Reconciliations)
Assert the Cash Reconciliations page loads and shows reconciliation records or a data table
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/purchase-requests (Purchase Requests)
Assert the Purchase Requests page loads and shows request list or data table
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/purchase-orders (Purchase Orders)
Assert the Purchase Orders page loads and shows order list or data table
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/goods-in-transits (Goods in Transit)
Assert the Goods in Transit page loads and shows shipment records or data table
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/price-quotation-requests (Quotation Requests)
Assert the Price Quotation Requests page loads and shows request list or data table
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/sales-targets (Sales Targets)
Assert the Sales Targets page loads and shows target list or data table
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/tasks (Task Management)
Assert the Tasks page loads and shows task list or data table
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/batches (Batch Management)
Assert the Batches page loads and shows batch list or data table
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/reports (Reports Page)
Assert the Reports page loads and shows report tabs for Visit Reports, Quotation Requests, Proforma Invoices, and Invoices
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/company-settings (Company Settings)
Assert the Company Settings page loads and shows company configuration fields
